Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Our cases fall into two main categories based on trip length and how you travel:
• Carry-On Luggage: Standard or Expandable models designed for 2–7 day trips. Sized to fit in overhead bins so you can skip baggage claim.
• Check-In Luggage: Standard or Expandable models built for week-long or extended journeys when you need maximum capacity.
For every model, you can choose a curated palette from our Designer Collection or custom-design your own case by picking colors for the shell, zipper, wheels, and handles.
